title: Regulatory change disrupts product portfolio
observations: A new regulation prohibits a previously profitable product configuration.
Customer demand shifts toward compliant substitutes.
Revenue decline begins immediately after the regulation takes effect.
participant_claims: Operations leaders say their process metrics remain within historical ranges.
researcher_interpretations: External policy change may dominate internal execution explanations.
assumptions: Revenue decline necessarily indicates operating failure.
missing_evidence: Segment demand before and after regulation.
